# API / Data Instructions

## Jekyll Data Files

This is a static site — there is no server-side API. "API" in this context refers to **Jekyll data files** (`_data/`) and the **Jekyll REST-like URLs** generated from collections and posts.

## Data Files (`_data/`)

- Store structured content as YAML (`.yml`) or JSON (`.json`) in `_data/`.
- Access in Liquid via `site.data.<filename>.<key>`.
- Example: `_data/experience.yml` → `{{ site.data.experience }}`

## URL Structure

| Resource | URL pattern |
|---|---|
| Blog post | `/<post-title>/` (set by `permalink: /:title/` in `_config.yml`) |
| Feed | `/feed.xml` |
| Sitemap | `/sitemap.xml` |

## Feed & SEO

- The RSS feed is auto-generated by `jekyll-feed` at `/feed.xml`.
- SEO meta tags are injected by `jekyll-seo-tag` using front matter (`title`, `description`, `image`).

## External Data

- Avoid fetching external APIs at build time unless using a Jekyll plugin.
- If dynamic data is needed (e.g., Strava stats), use JavaScript `fetch()` in a dedicated `<script>` block.

## Guidelines

- Do **not** store sensitive data in `_data/` files — the site is public.
- Keep data files small and flat; avoid deep nesting.
